newsitem.title: USA: CPI hurt by photofinishing oper earnings.
newsitem.headline: CPI hurt by photofinishing oper earnings.

text.p: CPI Corp said earnings from continuing operations for the July 20 second quarter were down due mainly to reduced photofinishing operating earnings and the disproportional impact of portrait studio fixed charges.
It also cited an increase in corporate expense due to higher employee benefit costs.

Total operating earnings fell to $4.6 million from $8.2 million in the 1995 second-quarter. CPI posted a net loss of $0.06 per share compared to a year-ago profit of $0.16, which included a $0.02 per share loss from discontinued operations.

"We remain optimistic concerning the balance of the year, because those same fixed charges will be reflected against the higher sales level during the year's highest seasonal period," said chairman Alyn Essman in a statement.
